value.answer: Tomorrow in Toronto is warm and wet: a high of 24, feeling like 28 with the humidex. A few showers end around noon, then it's mostly cloudy with a 60 percent chance of showers and a risk of thunderstorms through the morning and afternoon. Expect 10 to 20 mm of rain, and gusty southwest wind up to 40 km/h near noon. Low of 12 overnight. Wednesday looks better, with sun and cloud and a 30 percent chance of showers.
